questions.prompt: What must never happen? Phrase it as a sentence you'd say out loud.
questions.defaultHint: A user must never see another tenant's data.

questions.prompt: What must always be true immediately after a write?
questions.defaultHint: The written record is immediately readable by its owner.

questions.prompt: What is allowed to be eventually consistent, and what must be strictly consistent?
questions.defaultHint: Search index and notifications may lag; balances and permissions must not.

questions.prompt: Which numbers in your domain are money, and in which currencies?
What must be recorded permanently even if the underlying record is later deleted?
questions.defaultHint: An audit log entry of who did what, and when.
